text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"For opportunities where the competitor involved is Splunk, break down the count of lost opportunities and the total lost amount by month for fiscal year FY26 (Feb 2025 through Jan 2026), where lost means closed and not won.","measures":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.OPPORTUNITY_ID","aggregation":"count","alias":"lost_opportunities_count","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_CLOSED","op":"eq","values":[true],"source":"question"},{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_WON","op":"eq","values":[false],"source":"question"}]},{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.AMOUNT","aggregation":"sum","alias":"lost_amount","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_CLOSED","op":"eq","values":[true],"source":"question"},{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_WON","op":"eq","values":[false],"source":"question"}]}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.CLOSE_DATE","role":"time","grain":"month"}],"display":[],"filters":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity.COMPETITOR_C","op":"eq","values":["Splunk"],"source":"question"}],"expectedShape":"trend","time":{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.CLOSE_DATE","window":{"start":"2025-02-01","end":"2026-02-01","expression":"FY26"}},"unresolved":[],"provenance":{"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.OPPORTUNITY_ID":"q:Lost opportunities count","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.AMOUNT":"q:Lost Amount","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_CLOSED":"q:Lost","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_WON":"q:Lost","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.CLOSE_DATE":"q:by month for fiscal year FY26","dimension:opportunity.COMPETITOR_C":"q:competitor involved is Splunk"}}
